document.longDescription:
Treasure Trunk Theatre's official Prospect Heights pages describe a theater class for children ages 3 to 6 at Brooklyn Brainery in Prospect Heights. The official public class page lists the address as 190 Underhill Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11238.

The same official class page publishes a recurring Monday class from 3:30 PM to 4:15 PM and notes an optional PS9 after-school pickup for enrolled students. Treasure Trunk Theatre's official contact page lists phone (347) 762-9475.

Sources: https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/prospect_heights/ https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/classes-at-tt-prospect-heights/ https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/contact/ https://www.treasuretrunktheatre.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/267954_530012183688060_1916429731_n.jpg
